title: Grateful Dead Live at Stanley Theatre on 1972-09-28
lineage: MR > DAT > CDA > WAV > SHN > FLAC > DAW(Bertha) > SHN/CDA

ai_review.summary: Almost perfect soundboard capture (with scattered drop‑outs) of a peak‑1972 show featuring smoking Playing in the Band, He's Gone and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that sounds crisp on the short numbers but suffers from occasional drop‑outs. Musically the concert shines – the extended jams of Playing in the Band, He's Gone and The Other One are described as top‑10 1972 material, and even the brief tunes are well played with clear vocals.

ai_rating.rationale: Five‑star review praises both performance and overall sound quality; minor drop‑outs keep the recording from being rated excellent, but the show is highlighted as a 1972 peak.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and clear, especially on shorter songs; however scattered drop‑outs are noted throughout the tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shorter tunes are tight and vocal‑clear, while the extended jams deliver a peak‑1972 intensity, creating a strong overall flow.
